Container.Name: Courarr
Container.Overview: Auto-updating lists for Sonarr and Radarr. Anime lists come from AniList (this season, next season, genres, tags, popularity…) and are added to Sonarr as Anime series; TV & movie lists come from TMDB (trending, new releases, streaming service, network, genres, keywords…) and are added as Standard series. Courarr can create the Sonarr/Radarr import lists for you, and refreshes every day at 3 AM or on demand from the web UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and the list feed URLs Sonarr/Radarr poll.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database (lists, settings) and the cached anime ID mapping.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
